Name: Wiki Links by Aedenthorn
Author: BarleyZP
Description:
This is an unofficial update of Aedenthorn's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11476]Wiki Links[/url] for version 1.6.

The original code is available on [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]Github[/url]

Additional Tweaks:

- Added support for detecting game language and opening the appropriate version of the SDV wiki
- Manually tweaked preserves items like honey and jelly to go to the appropriate catchall wiki page in all supported languages
- Added support to go to the specific farm animal page when interacting with farm animals
- Added support for looking up trees


Source code for this update: [url=https://github.com/lisyce/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/AedenthornWikiLinks]Github[/url]
